description: Current TIE (foreigner identity card) pickup lote for a Spanish province: the latest lote released at each police office, lotes released this week and last week, the 3-week weekly average, and when it was observed. Optionally filter to one office by name. Returns page links on tiehoy.com.

lang.description: Language of the returned page links. Default en.

office.description: Optional office name or part of it, e.g. "Poblados" or "Rambla Guipúzcoa".

province.description: Spanish province, e.g. Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Alicante.

name: tiehoy_lote_status
title: TIE card lote status
